second.text: Joint review with curator: mandolin seam is stable with two cleats; coat only the pale exposed line using the one-to-nine amber trial. Add both the cleat positions and finish-removal method to the conservation record. We looked at the top first under the bench lamp and then under the warmer exhibition lamp. The repaired line is more noticeable under the bench lamp, but the curator prefers that to covering the surrounding original surface. Leave the little dark scratch beside the treble foot alone; it appears in the oldest photograph and is not part of this damage. Before applying colour, photograph the closed seam with a scale and mark the two cleats on a separate underside sketch. Attach the approved offcut sample number and isolation-coat notes so a future conservator can distinguish our touch-up from the original finish.
